### Ameriprise Financial Mobilizes Employees, Advisors and Clients to Support Hunger-Relief Organizations Ahead of the Holiday Season


November 4, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/618704162/files/doc_news/Ameriprise-Financial-Mobilizes-Employees-Advisors-and-Clients-to-Support-Hunger-Relief-Organizations-Ahead-of-the-Holiday-Season-2026.pdf)


***In 2026, Ameriprise granted $5 million to help support individuals, families and communities***


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Ameriprise Financial will mark its 17th annual **Ameriprise Day of Service** on Nov. 5, bringing together thousands of employees, advisors and clients to support hunger-relief efforts ahead of the holiday season. Working with Feeding America®, The Global FoodBanking Network, Meals on Wheels America and numerous local nonprofit organizations, volunteers will serve meals, sort bulk food donations, and host food drives, making a meaningful impact in communities where they live and work.


“Ameriprise Day of Service is a powerful example of what can happen when our employees, advisors and clients come together to help others,” said **Jennifer Jones, Head of Community Relations at Ameriprise** . “For 17 years, we have worked alongside nonprofit organizations dedicated to addressing hunger and strengthening communities. As food insecurity continues to affect many individuals and families, our volunteers are stepping up to help local partners expand access to meals during the holiday season.”


Since the inception of the Ameriprise Day of Service in 2009, the firm has helped provide more than 153 million meals and volunteers have contributed over 418,000 hours to hunger-relief efforts.


***Ameriprise Supporting More than 180 Nonprofits in Communities across the U.S. in 2026***


Complementing its companywide volunteer events, Ameriprise contributed more than $3 million in grants to 104 nonprofits in its second grant cycle of the year, supporting organizations that help meet essential needs, strengthen communities, and provide access to arts and culture. In total, the company donated more than $5 million and supported more than 186 nonprofits through its two grant cycles in 2026.


Ameriprise combines grantmaking, volunteer engagement and long-term relationships with nonprofits to help drive meaningful community outcomes. This year’s support spans hunger relief, housing and homelessness, the arts and other critical community needs. Examples include:


- **Feeding America:** Through its longstanding partnership with Feeding America, the nation’s largest hunger-relief organization, Ameriprise provides grant support and volunteer engagement, including the annual Ameriprise Day of Service. Together, these efforts help strengthen the nationwide network of food banks, food pantries and meal programs working alongside communities to address hunger.
- **Meals on Wheels America:** Increased support for Meals on Wheels America will help advance its End the Wait ® initiative, which builds local capacity through investments in infrastructure, workforce development, volunteer engagement and technology. The Meals on Wheels network reaches 2.6 million older adults annually through more than 5,000 local providers.
- **Pine Street Inn:** Pine Street Inn is the largest homeless services provider in New England, offering a comprehensive range of services to more than 3,100 individuals daily. Pine Street’s programs include housing with support services, emergency shelter, street outreach and workforce development.
- **Carnegie Hall:** This year also marks the 15th anniversary of Carnegie Hall’s Musical Connections program, which Ameriprise has funded since its inception. Musical Connections is a music residency at Sing Sing Correctional Facility that provides workshops in composition, songwriting, and performance for incarcerated men.


**About Ameriprise Financial Community Relations**


[Ameriprise Financial](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameriprise.com%2Fabout%2Fcommunity-impact%2Findex&esheet=54635315&newsitemid=20261104166060&lan=en-US&anchor=Ameriprise+Financial&index=1&md5=f0c956a0adedd67a2583bd18fa61e71d) is dedicated to utilizing the firm’s resources and talents to improve the lives of individuals and build strong communities. The firm was recently recognized by Newsweek as one of **America’s Most Charitable Companies** of 20261. Through grants, volunteerism and employee and advisor gift matching programs, the company supports more than 8,000 nonprofits globally. The company also has a longstanding commitment to volunteerism. Each year, the firm’s employees are eligible for eight hours of paid time off to volunteer. In 2025, Ameriprise volunteers collectively contributed more than 50,000 hours to nonprofits in communities across the country.


**About Ameriprise Financial**


At[Ameriprise Financial](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameriprise.com%2F&esheet=54635315&newsitemid=20261104166060&lan=en-US&anchor=Ameriprise+Financial&index=2&md5=860e9d46f0395844e7158b0681cb1945) , we have been helping people feel confident about their financial future for more than 130 years2. With extensive investment advice, global asset management capabilities and insurance solutions, and a nationwide network of more than 10,000 financial advisors, we have the strength and expertise to serve the full range of individual and institutional investors' financial needs.


1 Newsweek partnered with Statista to recognize America’s Most Charitable Companies. Eligible companies were evaluated September to December 2025 and scored on each of three items: survey of approximately 18,000 U.S. residents providing perceptions of companies’ philanthropic activities; social listening via mention tracking with sentiment across news and online sources; research of key performance indicators that represent important aspects of a company’s philanthropy performance. Ameriprise did not pay a fee to be evaluated but did pay a fee to publicly cite the results.


2 Company founded June 29, 1894
